posts.title: Mistakes Claude Code Makes on Embedded Code
posts.description: At Groundrun we have run a bunch of Claude Code on embedded projects and we found a bunch of interesting patterns: full write-up here.

posts.title: This 6502 Emulator Executes 1-3 Instructions Per Second (Written in Markdown, Running in an LLM)
posts.description: In previous posts we explored what happens if we treat LLMs as processors that run Markdown as their machine code: a user-space IP stack written in Markdown and a BASIC interpreter written in Markdown. Today we are going to look at an emulator for a 6502 microprocessor written in Markdown and executed with OpenCode and the GLM 5.1 model running on Grunden.ai.

posts.title: Tracking 100k Assets Before Having 100k Assets to Track: A Complex IoT System Built with AI Coding Agents
posts.description: How AI coding agents built a city-scale IoT asset tracking simulator in weeks, testing 100k+ Bluetooth assets across Birmingham before hardware arrived.
